entities.name: Emilya
entities.description: 14-year-old Orzhov girl killed by the Cult of Rakdos, became a ghost for 126 years and was returned to life, seeking vengeance on the Orzhov.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose deceit and corruption Emilya uncovers.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: Ghost city where Emilya spent her afterlife.

entities.name: Rusalka
entities.description: A spirit wrongfully killed seeking truth and justice, which Emilya became.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Mysterious stone entity that returned Emilya to life.

events.summary: Emilya is captured and hanged by the Rakdos, refusing to show fear.
events.quote: Emilya refused to show fear or weakness

events.summary: Emilya becomes a ghost in Agyrem.
Over 126 years Emilya learns the Orzhov used her death to gather wealth, and becomes a Rusalka.
events.quote: Emilya discovered that the Orzhov used her death to manipulate and gather wealth

events.summary: A colossal stone entity returns Emilya to life; she plans to expose the Orzhov.
events.quote: Emilya was miraculously returned to life by a mysterious, colossal stone entity

relations.quote: When captured and hanged by the Rakdos

relations.note: seeks vengeance on her former guild
